name: nahmeter-promo
description: nah.meter promo video (Remotion). Renders to out/; nothing here ships in the app.

scripts.audio: node scripts/make-timeline.mjs && node scripts/make-music.mjs && node scripts/make-audio.mjs
scripts.prepare-assets: npm run fonts && npm run audio
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:wide
scripts.render:showcase: npm run audio:showcase && remotion render NahShowcaseVertical out/nahmeter-showcase-vertical.mp4
scripts.audio:showcase: node scripts/make-timeline.mjs && MUSIC=none TICKS=none MIX=mix-showcase.wav node scripts/make-audio.mjs
scripts.render:showcase:4k: npm run audio:showcase && remotion render NahShowcaseVertical out/nahmeter-showcase-4k.mp4 --scale=2 --crf=16
